business: Minh AI Gateway: one OpenAI-compatible API for many AI models, paid from a VND wallet
target: Vietnamese developers and small software teams who already pay for LLM APIs (or want to) and struggle to pay with a foreign card or get a VAT invoice
where: Vietnam, online (mostly Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City)

segments.name: Freelancer / indie developer building side projects
Developer at a startup or small agency (2-20 people) who chooses the tools
Tech lead or CTO at an SME who must get a VAT invoice for every expense

behaviours.name: Grey-market buyer
behaviours.how: Already buys cheap 'Claude/GPT' credit from a Vietnamese reseller or Telegram group at about 1,500-1,700đ per dollar of usage.

behaviours.name: Pays the provider directly by card
behaviours.how: Has an international card and pays OpenAI/Anthropic directly; gets an English invoice the accountant can't use.

behaviours.name: Uses OpenRouter already
behaviours.how: Routes through OpenRouter, tops up in USD and accepts the 5.5% fee.

behaviours.name: Cost minimiser
behaviours.how: Picks the cheapest model that works, mainly DeepSeek or Qwen, and watches every đồng.

behaviours.name: Compliance-first buyer
behaviours.how: Can't spend company money without a valid Vietnamese e-invoice and a contract.

behaviours.name: Cautious experimenter
behaviours.how: Tries new dev tools on free credit, reads GitHub issues and Facebook dev groups before committing.

objections: Grey-market credit is much cheaper; why pay more?
A new one-person company could disappear with my prepaid balance
How do I know the model is really the one you say?
Adding a middleman adds latency and another point of failure
I already have a card and pay OpenAI/OpenRouter directly
Is it even allowed to resell Claude? Could my access be cut off?
Will the e-invoice actually be valid for my company's accounting?
habits: you read the J2TEAM and Vietnam developer groups on Facebook
you pay for most things with VietQR bank transfer from your phone
you use Cursor or a coding assistant every day
your accountant chases you every month for invoices
you have lost money before to a tool that shut down
